import json

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # find block: rows containing most common nonzero color (block color), bounding box
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r)
    blockcol=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    if blockcol==0: return inp
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==blockcol]
    cs=[c for i,r in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==blockcol]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    noise=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for c,v in enumerate(inp[i]):
            if v!=0 and v!=blockcol: noise.add((i,c))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,c in noise:
        pass
    # top half: shift block left to col0; noise rows left of block -> full row
    def base(i):
        row=[0]*W
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if 0<=c-c0<W: row[c-c0]=blockcol
        return row
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        row=base(i)
        # noise in this row left of c0?
        left=noise&[(i,c) for c in range(c0) if False] or None
        ln=[c for (ii,c) in noise if ii==i and c<c0]
        if ln:
            # full width block
            out[i]=[blockcol]*W
        else:
            out[i]=row[:]
        # paint noise on top (noise also within block cols)
        for c in noise:
            if c[0]==i: out[i][c[1]]=c[1]
    # bottom half: block pattern = block cols minus noise cols (rows>r1), painted at original position
    nbc={c for (i,c) in noise if i>r1}
    pc=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if c not in nbc]
    for i in range(r1+1,H):
        out[i]=[0]*W
        for c in pc: out[i][c]=blockcol
        for (ii,c) in noise:
            if ii>i: break
            if ii==i: out[i][c]=c
    return out

# verify demo1
a=G['Demo pair 1 input']; b=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print('d1 ok:', solve(a)==b)
a=G['Demo pair 2 input']; b=G['Demo pair 2 output']
print('d2 ok:', solve(a)==b)
res=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r if v!=0)
    blk=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==blk]
    cs=[c for i,r in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==blk]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    mk={}          # markers per column list of rows
    ms=[]           # markers
    for i,r in enumerate(inp):
        for c,v in enumerate(r):
            if v!=0 and v!=blk:
                ms.append((i,c)); mk.setdefault(c,set()).add(i)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # top part: shift block left to col 0; rows containing a marker INSIDE block cols -> full row
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        row=[0]*W
        if any((i,c) in ms for c in range(c0,c1+1)):
            out[i]=[blk]*(c1-c0+1)+[0]*(W-(c1-c0+1))  # partial full? check on demos
        else:
            for k in range(c0,c1+1):
                row[k-c0]=blk
        # copy markers in this row at original positions
        for (ii,c) in ms:
            if ii==i: out[i][c]=inp[i][c]
        out[i]=row
    # bottom part: start below block, paint block pattern shifted down by (r1-r0+1)? height h
    h=r1-r0+1
    # which pattern? bottom = vertical bars at columns present in block rows' marker columns union? explore both
    pc=sorted({c for _,c in ms} & range(c0,c1+1)|set(range(c0,c1+1)))
    return out,h,(r0,r1,c0,c1),ms,mk

    # compare bottoms ignoring top rows

from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r if v!=0)
    blk=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==blk]
    cs=[c for i,r in enumerate(inp) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v==blk]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ms=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(inp):
        for c,v in enumerate(r):
            if v!=0 and v!=blk: ms.append((i,c))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # top part (inside block rows)
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        row=list(inp[i])
        inside_m=[(ii,c) for ii,c in ms if ii==i and c0<=c<=c1]
        # markers inside band keep their value (already in row)
        if inside_m:
            # remove band block, redraw shifted left to col 0, restore markers
            row[c0:c1+1]=0
            for k in range(c0,c1+1): row[k-c0]=blk
        elif True:
            pass
        # decide fill extent by marker side in this row (outside band markers count)
        ls=[c for ii,c in ms if ii==i and c<c0]   # left-side markers
        rs=[c for ii,c in ms if ii==i and c>c1]   # right-side markers
        if ls and rs: row=W*[blk]                 # ambiguous -> full
        else:
            if rs:
                for k in range(c0): row[k]=blk      # extend left
            if ls:
                for k in range(c1,W): row[k]=blk     # extend right
        # if neither side (no outside markers), full width?
        if not ls and not rs: row=W*[blk]
        out[i]=row
    # bottom part: vertical stripes at band columns that have no marker BELOW the block
    exc={c for (i,c) in ms if i>r1 and c0<=c<=c1}
    for i in range(r1+1,H):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if c not in exc: out[i][c]=blk
    return out

print('d1 ok:', f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('d2 ok:', f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])

def f(g):
    import copy
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; m=len(g); n=len(g[0])
    val=g[0][0]
    four=[[r,c] for r in range(m) for c in range(n) if g[r][c]==val]
    if not four: return g
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in four),max(r for r,c in four)
    # find rectangle value: most common nonzero block? assume second color
    cnt={}
    for r in range(m):
        for c in range(n):
            if g[r][c]!=0: cnt[g[r][c]]=cnt.get(g[r][c],0)+1
    rect=sorted(cnt,key=cnt.get)[1]
    # locate rect extent
    ext=[(r,c) for r in range(m) for c in range(n) if g[r][c]==rect]
    c0=min(c for r,c in ext); c1=max(c for r,c in ext)
    out=[[0]*n for _ in range(m)]
    # paint rect rows spanned by 4s
    for r in range(min(r0,r1)):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=rect
    for r in range(max(r0,r1)+1,m):
        pass
    # paint rect rows for rows between/within r0..r1 inclusive
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if not (g[r][c]==val): out[r][c]=rect
    # repaint 4s everywhere
    for r,c in four: out[r][c]=val
    return out
